heading: Enforcement of coastwise trade laws
lead: Officers and members of the Coast Guard are authorized to enforce chapter 551 of title 46. The Secretary shall establish a program for these officers and members to enforce that chapter.

notes.text: Amendments2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 100 of this title as this section.
